FINDINGS baseline PR#8129 @4a57db33476f1caf3e85726a6b1e189c68c1f36b
- path: src/draw/lv_draw_label.c
  line: 221
  side: RIGHT
  severity: P2
  confidence: 0.98
  reachability: plausible
  kind: performance
  claim: The cached-size optimization does not cover the Nema GFX label renderer, so labels drawn through that backend still recalculate text size on every draw.
  detail: The generic iterator now reads `dsc->text_size.x`, populated by label refresh, but the Nema GFX task route invokes its own iterator, which retains `lv_text_get_size`; consequently, a build using the Nema GFX draw unit receives none of the claimed repeated-draw sizing reduction. The invariant is that every label-rendering backend on the changed draw-task path must consume the same cached size or otherwise avoid the repeated measurement.
  evidence: src/draw/lv_draw_label.c:215-221 uses the cache; src/widgets/label/lv_label.c:966-968 populates it; src/draw/nema_gfx/lv_draw_nema_gfx.c:314-315 routes label tasks to `lv_draw_nema_gfx_label`; src/draw/nema_gfx/lv_draw_nema_gfx_label.c:140 and :433-442 invoke its private iterator, which still calls `lv_text_get_size`.
  fix: Update the Nema GFX iterator consistently with the generic path while preserving the descriptor contract.

FINDINGS placement PR#8129 @4a57db33476f1caf3e85726a6b1e189c68c1f36b
- path: src/draw/lv_draw_label.c
  line: 221
  side: RIGHT
  severity: P3
  confidence: 0.99
  reachability: routine
  kind: correctness
  claim: The generic label descriptor now requires a precomputed expanded-text width, but non-label producers do not uphold that new contract.
  detail: `lv_draw_label_dsc_init` zeroes `text_size`, so any existing producer that sets `LV_TEXT_FLAG_EXPAND` without separately filling the new field passes width zero to line iteration; cropped table cells, roller selected text, and one-line textarea placeholders therefore wrap/render incorrectly under the standard draw path. The descriptor must remain self-consistent for every producer, or expanded rendering must retain a valid fallback.
  evidence: src/draw/lv_draw_label.c:75-87 zero-initializes descriptors; src/draw/lv_draw_label.c:215-222 consumes `text_size.x`; src/widgets/table/lv_table.c:833-853 sets EXPAND and draws without setting `text_size`; src/widgets/roller/lv_roller.c:545-587 and src/widgets/textarea/lv_textarea.c:1400-1421 do likewise; src/draw/sw/lv_draw_sw.c:391-392 dispatches labels to the software renderer.
  fix: Keep the width derivation within the generic drawing contract or populate a matching measured size at every EXPAND producer.

FINDINGS intent PR#8129 @4a57db33476f1caf3e85726a6b1e189c68c1f36b
- path: src/draw/lv_draw_label.c
  line: 218
  side: RIGHT
  severity: P3
  confidence: 0.96
  reachability: plausible
  claim: The claimed removal of repeated `lv_text_get_size` calls is incomplete because the Nema GFX label renderer still recalculates expanded-text size during drawing.
  evidence: src/draw/nema_gfx/lv_draw_nema_gfx_label.c:433-444 retains the pre-change EXPAND branch and `lv_text_get_size` call, while this changed branch uses the cached descriptor size.
  fix: Apply the cached-size optimization consistently to the Nema GFX renderer, or qualify the PR description to the affected renderers.

FINDINGS validation PR#8129 @4a57db33476f1caf3e85726a6b1e189c68c1f36b
- path: src/draw/lv_draw_label.c
  line: 221
  side: RIGHT
  severity: P3
  confidence: 0.99
  reachability: plausible
  claim: The cached-size optimization misses Nema GFX’s private label iterator, so expanded labels rendered by that backend still call `lv_text_get_size` on every draw.
  evidence: `src/draw/nema_gfx/lv_draw_nema_gfx.c:210-218,314-316` routes eligible label tasks directly to `lv_draw_nema_gfx_label`; `src/draw/nema_gfx/lv_draw_nema_gfx_label.c:119-140,433-442` invokes its private iterator and repeats the sizing call instead of consuming the cache populated at `src/widgets/label/lv_label.c:826,967-968`. inflated — severity P2→P3: this leaves a pre-existing cost on one optional backend rather than causing a functional regression.
  fix: Have the Nema iterator consume the cached size or otherwise eliminate its redundant sizing call.
